title.to: README: shift-left diagram, detection evidence, and GitBouncer migration

description.to: Local README now shows working/staged changes -> inspection before commit -> local history -> push/remote -> downstream clones/pulls. It distinguishes detected material blocked before commit from later checks after history exists, actual commit-msg timing, staged-diff limits, bypasses, overrides, HMAC trust and layered defenses. Both Mermaid diagrams parsed and rendered offline. GitBouncer branding and Data Parade positioning are being reconciled with the explicit naming decision; source publication remains pending.
